candidates.title: Design Drafter
candidates.abstract: Contribute to the design and delivery of infrastructure projects that create safer, greener and more connected city spaces.
bullets: A role where the City is your canvas
candidates.content_text:
- A role where the City is your canvas
 - Full time, permanent position
 - Starting at $109,361 + 12% super
About the Opportunity 
As part of the Infrastructure Program the Design Drafter will provide professional advice and input into the technical design, development, implementation and monitoring of a range of projects and proposals that contribute to achieving the City of Adelaide's Strategic Plan outcomes.
Some of the projects we are currently working on are:
 - Main Streets Revitalisation Program
 - School Safety and pedestrian safety program
 - Streetscape and laneway upgrades
 - City and Park Lands Bikeways
 - Park Lands upgrade projects
 - Major Stormwater upgrade and renewal projects.
 - Streetscape Renewal projects, incorporating Green Infrastructure.
To view the position description, please click here.
About You
To be successful in this role you will have:
 - Demonstrated technical knowledge of civil engineering and experience in designing / drafting in the civil and infrastructure field.
 - Proficiency in 12D modelling programs or Civil 3D.
 - High proficiency in AutoCAD and technical ability to produce accurate design drawings.
 - Manual design and drafting skills.
 - Demonstrated skills with Microsoft Office
 - Knowledge of Australian drafting standards, building construction, practices and techniques.
 - Experience in the delivery of design, documentation and quality assurance to meet highest industry standards and statutory regulations.
About Us
Located in the geographic heart of Kaurna Country, the City of Adelaide celebrates its cultural heritage, unique natural surrounds and structures its footprint in a way that allows it to adapt to the changing needs of the community and a dynamic global landscape. Our focus is on our community's wellbeing and quality of life - investing in city improvements and on future planning, so we continue to design a liveable city where future generations can continue to live authentic and meaningful lives. This is an exciting opportunity to join our team and be a bigger part of our amazing city!
The Infrastructure Program provides effective whole of life planning and management of our diverse community infrastructure assets and seeks partnerships with government bodies to deliver on Councils strategic plans, stimulating the local economy and supporting existing community needs and future growth. 
At the City of Adelaide, we thrive in an environment that is welcoming, inclusive and safe, and celebrates difference. We value and embrace our diverse perspectives and recognise the value diversity has in fuelling innovation and enabling brilliant experiences for our diverse community.
For Further Enquiries & How to Apply
All enquiries regarding this position will remain private and confidential and can be directed to Carina Green on 8203 7346.
Please submit a Resume and a Cover Letter expressing the skills, experience and qualities you would bring to the team addressed to Carina Green, Team Leader, Design. 
Please review the position description prior to submitting an application and follow the prompts to apply.
For more information about what it's like to work for the City of Adelaide and all the many benefits, please visit www.cityofadelaide.com.au/careers
Applications close at 11.59pm, 28 October 2026.
Please be advised this is a full time, permanent opportunity with a starting salary at the Level 6 Classification commencing at $109,361+ 12% superannuation.
As part of the recruitment process candidates will be required to undertake a National Police Check.
We continue to work hard to ensure our recruitment process is safe for people of diverse backgrounds. 
We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier-free recruitment process and supportive workplace. Our commitment to inclusivity means we welcome applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disabilities, and candidates from a range of lived experiences. If you require assistance with our recruitment process, you are more than welcome to connect with our People Services team on (08) 8203 7333 or via email: recruitment@cityofadelaide.com.au. Please note, applications received via this email address will not be considered.
